name: Estel
description: A young boy of Tidehollow whom Tezzeret sends to Bant with a box of etherium.

description_citations.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
description_citations.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret drives off a gang of children by animating a knife into its owner's hand, leaving the boy Estel behind.
timeline.quote: he turned, stood, and cast a spell to animate the knife in the leader's hand

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret retrieves his mother's box of etherium from the ruins of his childhood home.
timeline.quote: This was his mother's handiwork, the last remnant of the hobby that gave her solace amid the squalor.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians break through the cave ceiling, invading Tidehollow.
timeline.quote: Bone-white metal. The Phyrexians had arrived.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel with the box and an enchanted knife to Bant, telling him to say an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent him.
timeline.quote: When you see Rafiq, tell him that an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent you.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.
